intro: Ndi umutunganya-porogarame atanguye. Ndongora igikorwa co kubika server ASHIKA Network n'urutonde rwa server za Minecraft SABALISU, kandi ndategura porogarame ya server ya Minecraft Storia.
about: Ndacari mushasha, ariko nandika kode buri musi kandi ndiko ndatera imbere
Ndongora igikorwa canje bwite co kubika server
Ibibazo ku bikorwa vyanje canke ku buhinga birakaze: ndamutsa gusa kuri Discord
can_write: Ivyo nshobora kwandika (harimwo na kode itunganijwe nabi)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: server uhereye ku mayeni 30 ku kwezi
anw_p:
Igikorwa co kubika server ku bashaka gukoresha server ariko badashobora gutanga amahera menshi.
Tangura buhoro, **uhereye ku mayeni 30 gusa ku kwezi**.
sab_t: SABALISU: urutonde rwa server za Minecraft
sab_p:
Shira server yawe ya Minecraft ku rutonde maze uronke abantu bayikinirako.
Irafasha abakinyi barondera server n'abayifise bashaka kuyimenyekanisha.
storia_t: Storia: porogarame ya server ku server nini za Minecraft
storia_p: Fork y'isôko yuguruye ya Folia ku Minecraft 26.2. Na **Storia Cluster**, isi imwe irashobora gukora kuri server nyinshi icarimwe, kandi abakinyi bimuka hagati yazo ata kirahure co gupakira.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: isi imwe isangiwe na server nyinshi, n'amahuriro asobetse hagati yazo
**Relay y'ingoboka**: relay ya kabiri ibika kopi nzima kandi isubirira iya mbere iyo ibuze
**Imiterere ya Linear**: isi ifata nk'igice c'ikibanza kuri disiki
**Isi muri RAM**, **Tick Guard**, API ya plugin ku makuru asangiwe, n'ibindi
